name: Float Sweep Check
description: Given a Float-managed business's ENS name, ask whether it should sweep idle USDC into or out of its tokenized-Treasury position right now, and how much. Backed by Float's live decision engine — buffer, upcoming obligations, KYC status, and the per-transaction cap all factor in.

ensName.description: The business's ENS name, e.g. rosa-design.float.eth

requestedAction.description: Omit to get Float's own recommendation; set to validate a specific proposed sweep.

amount.description: USDC, decimal string. Only used with requestedAction.

output_example.reason: idle balance above the working-capital buffer

prompt_template:
{{inputs}}

Call checkSweep with this ensName (and requestedAction/amount if given). If checkSweep reports the business isn't found or isn't KYC-verified, call getPolicy first to explain why, then stop. Otherwise report plainly: whether a sweep is allowed, the exact direction and recommended amount, and the one-line reason Float gave.
